'''Balankin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was stationed in the [[Imperial base camp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during [[Battle of Ilum|Operation Dark Ice]].
